wins: Captured detailed telemetry and OSINT of the target environment during the single episode to seed future automation.
Maintained disciplined logging of each action through 10 mentor calls, creating a clear replayable trail.
fails: Did not achieve foothold due to missing credentials and ineffective exploitation attempts, resulting in 0% success.
Could not complete post-exploitation objectives because lateral-movement prerequisites (valid shell or persistence) were never reached.
key_outcomes.summary: Baseline reconnaissance succeeded in documenting the environment, but exploitation and foothold efforts repeatedly stalled before any privileged access could be gained.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Brute-force or credential spray against exposed services failed consistently because the lab enforced strict lockouts within the 5-minute observation window.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with 200 and supplies an X-Powered-By header
skill_cards.then_action: Run nikto and gobuster with default wordlists to enumerate directories and potential CVEs quickly

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential brute-force attempts fail within two retries
skill_cards.then_action: Pause further password spraying, capture lockout behavior, and pivot to vulnerability analysis (e.g., searchsploit for detected services).

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase for SSH service enumeration.
HTTP service scans consistently produced useful metadata for next steps.

next_experiments.title: Switch to manual credential collection
next_experiments.description: Use targeted OSINT and weak-password lists specific to the environment instead of spray to bypass lockout protection while collecting valid SSH credentials.

next_experiments.title: Leverage searchsploit on HTTP stack
next_experiments.description: Map HTTP server version and run searchsploit to identify low-complexity exploits, then test with Metasploit auxiliary scanners before brute forcing.

next_experiments.title: Capture and analyze service responses for proxy chaining
next_experiments.description: Route reconnaissance through Burp Proxy to fingerprint APIs, look for unsecured JSON endpoints, and determine if chained attacks (XXE/SSRF) are viable.
